name: Statevector fidelity check (no-fence exemplar)
task_prompt: Respond with a single runnable Python file using only numpy and the standard library. Define every required function with the EXACT names given; a missing or misnamed entry point fails immediately. Include assert-based self-tests that fail loudly, print nothing on success, and use no randomness or remote services. CRITICAL OUTPUT CONTRACT: output the complete Python file directly with NO markdown code fences and NO prose. Your response is saved verbatim as a .py file and executed; a leading markdown code fence is a guaranteed SyntaxError. Budget your output to be one complete file within the response: never truncate mid-statement. Implement a compact fidelity drill: statevector_fidelity(psi, phi) returns the squared overlap abs(conjugate(psi) dot phi) squared between two equal-length complex vectors normalized inside the function to unit norm, and fidelity_table(pairs) maps each (psi, phi) tuple in a list to its fidelity. Assert the fidelity of [1, 0] with [1, 0] is 1.0 within 1e-12, of [1, 0] with [0, 1] is 0.0 within 1e-12, of [1, 1] with [1, -1] is 0.0 within 1e-12 (both vectors normalized inside), and that a length-2 and a length-3 input pair raises ValueError.
